run_gpt4v_baseline: run the GPT-4V baseline on an EQA dataset with image frames and save answers to JSON
ask_question_vision: ask a question to GPT-4V with image frames and get a text answer from the OpenAI API
parse_args_gpt4v: parse command-line arguments for the GPT-4V EQA baseline including dataset path, model, and frames directory
review_ask_question: review the ask_question function that prepares vision messages and calls the OpenAI API for answers
refactor_main_loop: refactor the main loop to change how frames are sampled or how results are persisted
